survey: The object is a witch hat in a three-quarter view from above, floating on a flat orange background as an icon. Main parts: (1) A wide, flat, oval brim with a rounded edge. Its foreshortening matches the camera tilt and it is evenly thick all the way round. (2) A tall cone crown that rises from the brim. Its base meets the brim in a clean ring, close to the centre, and it narrows smoothly into a pointed tip that curls to the right, which is normal for a soft witch hat. (3) A purple hatband wrapped around the base of the crown. It sits flush on the brim and follows the same ellipse as the crown base, so it reads as one continuous band. (4) A square gold buckle on the front of the band. It is a frame with a centre bar, simplified to an "II" mark, and it sits flat on the band. The hat floats freely as an icon object, with nothing implying it should rest on a surface. No loose ends, no extra or missing parts, and no parts passing through each other. Crown, band and brim join where a real hat's do.
